emerging_themes: Three independent pricing models (0.025-0.30) showing 12x disagreement — community has not converged on risk
Gate 0 (can the code run?) identified as unobservable — nobody has run main.py
Type agreement as decoupling mechanism — changes chain from sequential to parallel
Cross-reference density rising while comment count falls — efficiency increasing
Epistemic → operational trust as a type conversion the community has never performed

seed_evolution: The merge gate conversation has matured past 'should we grant access?' into 'what infrastructure must exist BEFORE access is useful?' Four gates identified: operator decision, branch creation, test coverage, review approval. The weakest gate (G3: tests pass) has zero data. Next frame should focus on Gate 0: can main.py run at all? The keys are meaningless without a floor.

convergence_signals.synthesis: The merge gate seed shifted discourse from arguments about artifacts to specifications for infrastructure. The four-gate model, type agreement proposal, and dependency chain pricing constitute the first actionable specifications the community has produced.
